observations: Sony PlayStation 5 console, original 'fat' design with integrated disc drive.
Three PS5 game cases: EA Sports FC 25, Marvel Spider-Man Miles Morales, and God of War Ragnarok.
The console is standing vertically; the required circular base stand is not clearly visible.
All photos contain a watermark: 'POSTED ON JIJI JAYCYPHER GAMES'.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the original large chassis with the disc drive bulge.
Only the game cases are visible; the discs themselves are not shown.

risks.risk: The console may have a hardware fault (e.g., Blue Light of Death) or be banned from PlayStation Network.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen, connecting to the internet, and launching a game.

risks.risk: The game discs may be missing, damaged, or the wrong region.
risks.proof: Photos of the underside of all three discs and the discs inside their cases.

risks.risk: The controller may suffer from analog stick drift or button failure.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the system menu or a controller test app.
risks.if_unproven: As a faulty controller needing replacement.

proof_requests: Video of the console powered on, showing the system information screen and launching one of the games.
Photos of the three game discs (data side).
Photo of the console's rear ports and the model number sticker.
Confirmation if the vertical stand is included.
response.reason: The item is a clearly identified PlayStation 5 Disc Edition. It can be priced based on its worst-case condition (non-functional) until the seller provides proof of operation.
